svg.title: Part number and serial number structure
svg.text: Structure of drawing, part, serial and order numbers (fixed fields + running number, no meaning in the running number)
Monospace characters: each field has a fixed length; hyphen = field separator; only A–Z, 0–9 and '-'.
MAKE part number = drawing number without revision:
VC-PRD-CC-0020 (revision C is a separate ERP field)
2 BUY part B-<class>-<5 digits> Raw material R-<class>-<5 digits>
One number per exact catalogue item;
maker + order code are ERP attributes,
capacity = 99 999 per type code per ISO week
5 Product part-number plan VC10 / VC20 / VC30 (assigned numbers – software must not decode them)
Guide 15 – numbering and identification · digital twin
